label: The sentence 'there is evil in the…, from An all-powerful being is able to eliminate… and 14 more
meaning: Answer map for Q-MORAL-GROUNDING (what makes something objectively good or evil?). O'Connor's emotivism: no objective grounding, because moral statements have no truth value (OCONNOR-DESTINY-ETHICS-EMOTIVISM; in 2016, no objective moral truths, OCONNOR-TUREK-EVIL-NO-OBJECTIVE-MORAL-TRUTHS). Catholic theory: goodness is the same in reality as being in act (ST I q.5 a.1); evil is the privation of a due good (q.48 a.3); 'there is evil' is true when such a privation is in a subject (q.48 a.2 ad 2). Naturalist moral realism: not covered by this result (Railton and Boyd are pinned since #249, but no naturalist cell for this evidence item is formalized). This result is the Catholic coverage cell for the evidence item 'there is evil' (the general premise of ST I q.2 a.3 obj. 1): the Catholic theory entails it (the shared-background hypothesis is in the theorem's signature but unused by the proof). The theory enters as one bundle hypothesis (`Catholic s`), and bind-check binds each of its 14 conjuncts to a premise listed here. The emotivism cell (contradicted) is POE-EXTERNAL-PREMISE-VS-EMOTIVISM, but that cell concerns the narrower moral-evil premise (man-made evil). Aquinas' malum is privation, metaphysical as well as moral, so the two cells are distinct evidence items and are not merged. A scoped conditional Catholic cell for culpa (ST I q.48 a.5), POE-CATHOLIC-ABSENT-OPERATION-CULPA-AND-EVIL, now classifies an absent due voluntarily controlled operation as culpa and privative evil. It supplies no existence cell for the narrower man-made-evil premise and no sentence bridge to O'Connor. Proof shape: two steps (deficiency plus privation gives evil in some being; propositional truth gives the premise). Most listed commitments are unused, because the cell is stated for the whole theory. The frozen Catholic bundle retains STMT-GOD-DRAWS-GOOD-FROM-EVERY-EVIL as an open, disputed strengthening of ad 1: actual production for every existing evil with no explicit permission condition. Collective scope, permission-conditioned policy and capability readings are recorded separately in DISAMB-AD1-GOOD-FROM-EVIL. Neither this result nor its model establishes that stronger source attribution, actual divine permission, or the philosophical truth of that commitment.
